woodcutter-radius.label: Woodcutter Forest Radius
labels: Controls the woodcutter productivity circle. Default: 4. Vanilla maximum: 8.

needed-woodcutter-trees.label: Needed Woodcutter Trees
labels: Controls the forest area needed by Roman and Celtic woodcutters. Default: 40. Vanilla maximum: 80.

needed-roman-charcoal-trees.label: Needed Roman Charcoal Trees
labels: Controls the forest area needed by Roman charcoal kilns. Default: 40. Vanilla maximum: 80.

needed-celtic-charcoal-trees.label: Needed Celtic Charcoal Trees
labels: Controls the forest area needed by Celtic charcoal kilns. Default: 40. Vanilla maximum: 80.

Description.English: Adds a configurable woodcutter forest radius plus independent tree-requirement sliders for woodcutters, Roman charcoal kilns, and Celtic charcoal kilns. Tree requirements default to half their vanilla values, allowing farms, ornaments and landscaping to be placed closer to forestry buildings. Charcoal-kiln radii remain vanilla. Existing saves are supported.
